40class m2 : public WscAttrList {
41public:
42 // WSC M2 configuration (inputs to m2::init/create)
43 struct config {
44 /* WSC message type; must be WSC_MSG_TYPE_M2 */
45 eWscMessageType msg_type{eWscMessageType::WSC_MSG_TYPE_M2};
46
47 /* Enrollee/Registrar nonces (from M1 / freshly generated) */
48 uint8_t enrollee_nonce[WSC_NONCE_LENGTH]{};
49 uint8_t registrar_nonce[WSC_NONCE_LENGTH]{};
50
51 /* Registrar public key (DH) */
52 uint8_t pub_key[WSC_PUBLIC_KEY_LENGTH]{};
53
54 /* Encryption/Auth type flags advertised in M2 */
55 uint16_t encr_type_flags{0};
56 eWscAuth auth_type_flags{eWscAuth::WSC_AUTH_OPEN};
57
58 /* Device identity block shown in M2 */
59 std::string manufacturer{};
60 std::string model_name{};
61 std::string model_number{};
62 std::string serial_number{};
63 uint16_t primary_dev_type_id{0};
64 std::string device_name{};
65
66 /* RF bands capability advertised in M2 */
67 eWscRfBands bands{WSC_RF_BAND_2GHZ_5GHZ};
68
69 /* WSC Encrypted Settings payload (ConfigData ciphertext) and IV */
70 std::vector<uint8_t> encrypted_settings{};
71 uint8_t iv[WSC_ENCRYPTED_SETTINGS_IV_LENGTH]{};
72
73 /* Optional BSS index (included only if bss_index_support == true) */
74 uint8_t bss_index{0};
75
76 /* Hidden SSID flag (Airties Vendor Extension subelement: hidden_ssid) */
77 eWscVendorExtHiddenSsid hidden_ssid = WSC::eWscVendorExtHiddenSsid::UNSET;
78
79 /* WSC VAP Type */
80 eVapType vap_type = eVapType::OTHER;
81
82 /* WSC VAP Label */
83 std::string vap_label{};
84 };

135 eWscVendorExtHiddenSsid hidden_ssid() const
136 {
137 for (auto &vendor_ext_attr : getAttrList<WSC::cWscAttrVendorExtension>()) {
138 if ((WSC::eWscVendorId::WSC_VENDOR_ID_AIRTIES_1 != vendor_ext_attr->vendor_id_0()) ||
139 (WSC::eWscVendorId::WSC_VENDOR_ID_AIRTIES_2 != vendor_ext_attr->vendor_id_1()) ||
140 (WSC::eWscVendorId::WSC_VENDOR_ID_AIRTIES_3 != vendor_ext_attr->vendor_id_2())) {
141 continue;
142 }
143
144 auto vendor_data = vendor_ext_attr->vendor_data();
145 if (vendor_data[0] == WSC::vendor_extension::airties::VENDOR_BSS_CFG) {
146
147 // Hidden BSS attribute is set
148 return (vendor_data[1] == WSC::vendor_extension::airties::VENDOR_HIDE_SSID)
149 ? eWscVendorExtHiddenSsid::ENABLED
150 : eWscVendorExtHiddenSsid::DISABLED;
151 }
152 }
153 return eWscVendorExtHiddenSsid::UNSET;
154 };
155 eVapType vap_type() const
156 {
157 for (auto &vendor_ext_attr : getAttrList<WSC::cWscAttrVendorExtension>()) {
158 if ((WSC::eWscVendorId::WSC_VENDOR_ID_AIRTIES_1 != vendor_ext_attr->vendor_id_0()) ||
159 (WSC::eWscVendorId::WSC_VENDOR_ID_AIRTIES_2 != vendor_ext_attr->vendor_id_1()) ||
160 (WSC::eWscVendorId::WSC_VENDOR_ID_AIRTIES_3 != vendor_ext_attr->vendor_id_2())) {
161 continue;
162 }
163
164 const auto *data = vendor_ext_attr->vendor_data();
165 const size_t len = vendor_ext_attr->vendor_data_length();
166
167 // Need at least 2 bytes: [subelem_id][value]
168 if (len >= 2 && data[0] == WSC::vendor_extension::airties::VENDOR_VAP_TYPE) {
169
170 const uint8_t raw = data[1];
171
172 if (!eVapTypeValidate::check(raw)) {
173 LOG(WARNING) << "Invalid VAP type received in vendor extension: " << int(raw)
174 << " -> using OTHER";
175 return eVapType::OTHER;
176 }
177
178 return static_cast<eVapType>(raw);
179 }
180 }
181
182 return eVapType::OTHER;
183 }
184
185 std::string vap_label() const
186 {
187 for (auto &vendor_ext_attr : getAttrList<WSC::cWscAttrVendorExtension>()) {
188 if ((WSC::eWscVendorId::WSC_VENDOR_ID_AIRTIES_1 != vendor_ext_attr->vendor_id_0()) ||
189 (WSC::eWscVendorId::WSC_VENDOR_ID_AIRTIES_2 != vendor_ext_attr->vendor_id_1()) ||
190 (WSC::eWscVendorId::WSC_VENDOR_ID_AIRTIES_3 != vendor_ext_attr->vendor_id_2())) {
191 continue;
192 }
193
194 const auto *data = vendor_ext_attr->vendor_data();
195 const size_t len = vendor_ext_attr->vendor_data_length();
196
197 // Need at least 2 bytes: [subelem_id][value]
198 if (len >= 2 && data[0] == WSC::vendor_extension::airties::VENDOR_VAP_LABEL) {
199 return std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char *>(data + 1), len - 1);
200 }
201 }
202
203 return {};
204 }
205};
